title: wg: protocol-06 §5.7 operation/endpoint mismatch unspecified
description: Suggestion. §5.7 defines request/cancel for requestConsent and grant/revoke for updateConsent, but never says what a server does when an operation is posted to the wrong endpoint (e.g. grant to requestConsent). mimid's codec leaves it to the server. Fix: state the required error response.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED minor: no 4xx for wrong consentOperation. Low-priority issue.
